statement: Every exponential fraction along a based continuous path in R semidirect R² with any two real diagonal weights is a word of length at most 13363205 in path values and their inverses. The bound includes zero, equal and opposite weights and is independent of the path. It extends all C54 source contractions of dimension at most three through arbitrary accumulation, enlarging the closed exponential region and the relative finite-operator-representative extension of C55.

notes: A maximizing path-value anchor gives translation commutators. A five-letter additive path formula leaves an exact product error, expressed through six smooth scalar correction functions. Uniform bounds on each function and derivative permit bounded interpolation after division by (exp(x)+exp(-x))^8 in the coordinate tanh(x). Two explicit Laurent-polynomial conjugation paths realize the interpolation, with coefficient bounds75 and70 and word cost5120 per path value. The planar signed-path identity handles each bounded fractional translation, giving the stated exact uniform count. The finite certificate checks rational group, commutator, signed-product, Laurent and correction formulas across six weight regimes; analytic bounds and path selection are proved independently. The C50 global compact-word and based winding argument then applies with this fixed larger bound. The full four-dimensional Aff⁺(R)² case, arbitrary remaining local quotients, and exterior nonopen extension remain unresolved parts of C12.
